subject: HANDOFF V2: physical-panel ID cache finding revalidated after Gen3 Alpha1 production commit
body: SUPERSEDES main-pin portion of msg-state-rd-handoff-physical-panel-id-revalidation-20261002t001943z. WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-physical-panel-id-revalidation-20261002. FINAL_PRODUCTION_MAIN_SHA=179e688e234fd54cedf99aa7792c86de00bba947 (Introduce Fold7 Gen3 transition architecture alpha1). Gen3 materially changed DuoShellService.kt (new blob 8861092dad4011fbaacd4d1ef3247bd6ea33faaa), so the target boundary was re-read directly after the production commit. RESULT=STILL_APPLICABLE. cachedCoverPhysicalDisplayId assignments remain only declaration + successful resolution (lines 80/959/971 in this revision); cachedInnerPhysicalDisplayId assignments remain only declaration + successful resolution (80s/990 path); no invalidation/reset was added. resolveFold7CoverPhysicalDisplayId and resolveFold7InnerPhysicalDisplayId still return cached numeric IDs immediately, and setPhysicalPowerNormal still performs a fresh getPhysicalDisplayToken(id) each call but returns failure without evicting/re-resolving a missing cached ID. Gen3 adds additional physical-cover call sites but does not alter this lifetime contract. Therefore the packaged model/prototype and recommended bounded no-token self-heal remain source-valid against current Gen3 production. Device validation remains required before integration. No production writes were made by this R&D agent.
